notes: The Marrow Tomb (dungeon_tomb). Built on templates\belfry_template.flp: marimba_bone on bell_marrow (Analog Harp, insert 7), drone_low on brass_low (12 Low Strings, Osc2 off, +12, insert 8), drum_frame on drum_taiko (insert 3, key 41 plays 42 as in Cinderreach), choir_dark on choir (Ah Voice, insert 4). v2 (review v1 MAJOR): the Analog Harp marimba rang for seconds (VCA decay 2 ms, sustain 10, release 3.3 s); both VCA rows now decay 1.3 s, sustain 1.5 of 10, release 0.17 s, edited in projects\dungeon_tomb_v2a.flp, and its insert is 9.5 dB higher to keep its level.
